text.en: Gaia embodies Mother Earth. The story moves from a living world in balance through human disruption and planetary distress toward refuge, protection, ethical reflection, renewal and renewed ties between people and nature. The healing is a collective responsibility.
text.zh-TW: Gaia 是大地母親的化身。故事從平衡的生命世界出發，經歷人為失序與地球受損，走向庇護、守護、良知反思、重生，以及人類與自然重新建立關係。修復有賴共同承擔。

text.en: Children and pets opened the festival.
text.zh-TW: 兒童與寵物嘉年華為活動揭幕。

text.en: RRI documented the WACI parade and Novia Bachmid’s closing performance. Its Artwear report covers a separate runway for conceptual fashion and local designers that evening.
text.zh-TW: RRI 記載 WACI 遊行以及 Novia Bachmid 的壓軸演出。當晚另有 Artwear 伸展臺，讓概念服裝與在地設計師亮相。

text.en: The closing Grand Carnival opened with a Gaia-centered theatrical prologue. Roots led the street portion along roughly 3.6 km from Central Park Jember to GOR PKPSO Kaliwates.
text.zh-TW: 閉幕主遊行先演出以 Gaia 為核心的劇場序幕，接著由 Roots 領先上街，從 Central Park Jember 到 GOR PKPSO Kaliwates，約 3.6 公里。

text.en: The press release’s sequence is a narrative list. The Grand Carnival rundown lists the scheduled defile slots from Roots to Sanctuary. Post-event accounts confirm Roots led the street parade after the Gaia stage prologue. The published schedule does not establish the complete observed street order.
text.zh-TW: 新聞稿的順序是故事章節名單。主遊行節目表列出的分隊時段以 Roots 開頭、Sanctuary 收尾；會後報導證實 Gaia 先在舞臺序幕出場，接著 Roots 領先上街。這份節目表不足以確認實際街頭隊列的完整順序。

text.en: Organizers announced a unified LED staging concept as a storytelling aid. The specific screen layout and its full execution were not independently established here.
text.zh-TW: 主辦方預告以整合式 LED 舞臺輔助敘事。此資料庫尚未獨立證實實際配置與完整執行情況。
